reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Allow crossplane to merge existing MRDs from provider MRDs by @n3wscott in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6685", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: In an environment that has existing MRDs, Crossplane may now merge them from provider MRDs, so those definitions can be modified by provider-supplied definitions where previously Crossplane did not merge them.
consequence.remediation: If you maintain existing MRDs, review them after the upgrade to see whether provider MRDs have been merged into them.

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 now allows Crossplane to merge existing MRDs from provider MRDs.
